title: MintyFest
tagline: The project is a dApp that allows event organizers and their sponsors to reward and boost participant enthusiasm with exclusive NFTs.
description: Event organizers and sponsors can allow participants to obtain exclusive NFTs at the event. Each sponsor can offer a wide variety of NFT products, which can be free, paid, or auctioned for the rarest items. Participants will be able to view the available NFT collection at the event and attempt to complete it. To access a sponsor's page, participants will need to scan the QR code at their booth, encouraging more interaction with the sponsors and adding a gamification element with a mini collection to complete.
how_its_made: We start from scratch, build a 'vite' react app for the frontend and we use Rainbow, Wagmi (with viem). For the backend we use Hardhat and Pinata to store and interact with NFT on the blockchains. For some datastorage we also use firebase to keep track of certains values needed by our frontend.
